(A) The OSF deposit carries the authors' derived score P.Wisdom. Over the 674 wave-0 respondents with a complete 12-item record, an exhaustive search of 57,344 scoring rules (every 11- and 12-column subset x every reversal subset x reversal constant 7-x or 8-x) reproduces P.Wisdom to max abs deviation 4.44e-15 for exactly one rule: the mean of 11 columns with Cog_1 dropped, Cog_2/Cog_3/Cog_4/Refl_2/Refl_3/Refl_4/Aff_3/Aff_4 entered as 7-x and Refl_1/Aff_1/Aff_2 entered raw (next-best rule deviates by 0.394). The 3D-WS-12 has exactly three positively-worded items, r8r, a4r and a7r, and the shipped mapping puts them at exactly Refl_1, Aff_1, Aff_2 -- 1 in 24 under a random within-facet permutation. This also refutes the rival ordering (the 3D-WS-12 questionnaire's own 1..12 order), which would put r10 at Refl_1. (B) Reflective block, n=1,010 complete person-wave records live: observed within-facet item-rest correlations are Refl_4=0.595, Refl_2=0.591, Refl_3=0.525, Refl_1=0.206 against Thomas et al. (2017) Fig. 2 loadings r12 .69, r9 .63, r10 .50, r8r .34 -- the same rank order; and the largest excess over the 1-factor prediction falls on r(Refl_3,Refl_4)=0.527 vs predicted 0.345 (+0.182), which under the shipped mapping is exactly the r10<->r12 residual covariance Fig. 2 frees. Scored over all 6 permutations of {r9,r10,r12}, the shipped permutation is the UNIQUE one passing both tests. WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH: (i) Aff_1 vs Aff_2 (a4r vs a7r) and Aff_3 vs Aff_4 (a9 vs a12) -- (A) pins the pairs, not the order inside them, and the affective loadings do not replicate at all (published a12 .60 is the strongest affective item while Aff_4's item-rest 0.259 is the weakest of the four, so one statistic actively dissents from the shipped a12 placement); (ii) the entire cognitive within-facet order -- all four cognitive items are negatively worded so (A) is silent, and the observed order Cog_3>Cog_2>Cog_1>Cog_4 matches neither candidate ordering's loading prediction (shipped predicts Cog_2>Cog_4>Cog_3>Cog_1), so any of the 24 orders of c9/c10/c11/c13 is consistent with the data and the shipped one rests on the parent-numbering rule that (A) and (B) confirm for the other two facets. It is also a structural match, not a source-level label tie: the deposit is a bare CSV with no variable labels, so no file anywhere states a code-to-item correspondence. Hence PARTIAL.
